title: Does the recipe's best keep fraction fall as context grows? Keep 70%..1.25% at 2k-64k, single-length pools, dense held-out-loss proxy
result: No. Best keep is 20-40% at every length the proxy resolves and does not fall with length: 8k 40% (tied with 20%), 16k 20-40% tie, 32k 40% beats the recipe at matched FLOPs on both seeds (-0.019 / -0.010 CE; 70% ties: -0.022 / -0.002), 64k 20% (40% +0.015 / +0.017 on both seeds). Low keeps break harder the longer the rows: 10% vs the recipe at matched FLOPs +0.003 CE at 8k, +0.002/+0.014 at 16k, +0.011/+0.031 at 32k, +0.080/+0.033 at 64k; 2.5% collapses at 32k/64k and 1.25% at 64k (+0.60). Constant fraction fits; a constant kept-token count (would predict 20/10/5% at 16/32/64k) is rejected. 2k/4k saturate (held-out CE ~0.01): unresolvable. Below 20% the per-step FLOP saving flattens (64k: 0.185 -> 0.140x dense) because blocks 0-6 stay dense. Margins between 20% and 40% are no larger than the seed spread (up to 0.027 CE at 64k). A 70% arm at 64k is still running. Proxy: eval_size 144 per length (below 500), ranks only, cannot resolve < ~0.03-0.05 CE.

title: Gold-aware stochastic keep (grJ) and its outlier-safe variant (grJc, document drop on contradiction only) at 32k and 64k
result: grJ: largest mean speedups (6.2x at 32k, 8.4x at 64k vs dense full FT at its mid-epoch CE; 0.08 / 0.067 of dense FLOPs per step) but outlier never reaches that level (final outlier CE 0.249 vs 0.187 at 32k, 0.284 vs 0.220 at 64k): the mean hides an outlier stall. grJc: 32k 4.16x / 4.15x mean (2 seeds), worst task 2.82x on seed 0 but contradiction not reached on seed 1; ends 0.015-0.019 CE above 40%/14% at equal steps (contradiction +0.04). 64k (1 seed): 4.10x mean, contradiction (0.191 vs 0.086) and outlier do not reach dense's mid-epoch level. Outlier-safe at 32k, not at 64k; contradiction is its weak task. Proxy, eval_size 144.
